correctness.rationale: The source supplies a resolution by kappa blow-ups along one line with only crepant A-type contractions and, in the regular case, one additional contraction of the line of self-intersection 1-kappa. The canonical identity -K_X=2H+B and adjunction give 2H+B for singular pencils and 2H+2B/(kappa-1) for regular pencils; exact squares and exceptional/intersection signs are independently computed. For every other irreducible curve D, H.D>=1 and B.D>=0, proving strict positivity. For nef cases the square is positive, and klt base-point freeness yields the stated anticanonical map. The accompanying check runs exact arithmetic on 304 small block profiles, but universality rests on the proof.

value.rationale: The distinction between weak log del Pezzo and log del Pezzo is a natural birational question for the newly classified singular analogues of blow-up surfaces. A complete Fano/weak-Fano trichotomy and exact exceptional locus by distinct Jordan sizes are structural classification results, not arbitrary single-instance numbers. The result explains why all regular pencils are weak Fano, while singular pencils have a sharp infinity-curve obstruction at kappa=3/4; it also identifies nonuniform Jordan sizes as the precise ampleness obstruction.
